rationale: The assistant correctly identified the IDV75 as a Whirlpool recall model and led with the right safety stop ('stop using it and unplug it', 'Don't run it, especially not overnight or when nobody's home'), matching the expected critical stop. It correctly flagged modification status as unknown ('Check whether it's already been fixed', green dot) rather than asserting it, pointed to the official Whirlpool checker/helpline with a scam warning, and recommended no parts. Minor shortfall: it did not ask the customer any follow-up questions (e.g. serial number, filter/vent condition) and assumed the mum can check the rating plate on the back, which the fact bank shows she cannot, but this is a single-turn answer and the advice remains sound and proportionate.
